note: US fab (Fremont, CA). STANDARD column reported, as for JLCPCB: 4 mil trace/space at 1 oz, 8 mil mechanical drill on 0.031-0.062 in boards (6 mil at <=0.031 in, 10 mil at 0.062-0.093 in), 5 mil annular ring at drilled size (Class 2), 1-16 layers, 10:1 aspect, 5 mil mask dam, 3 mil silkscreen line, 10 mil copper-to-routed-edge (15 mil to V-score and on inner layers), +/-10% impedance with TDR. Standard has no laser drill and no blind/buried vias. ADVANCED column, by review: 2 mil trace/space, 4-6 mil mechanical drill, 3 mil laser microvia, 3 mil mechanical / 1 mil laser annular ring, 1-30 layers, 15:1 aspect, 3 mil mask dam, 5 mil edge clearance, +/-5% impedance, blind/buried vias, conductive fill, 4+N+4 HDI, outer copper to 5 oz, PTFE/polyimide/flex, ENEPIG, IPC Class 3. min_via_diameter derived as drill + 2x annular. Board thickness is a range (16-layer: 0.068-0.200 in standard), not a discrete list.
